But the simple reality is that the facts don't support your narrative.

Marvel is still the largest comic book company in the world despite having fewer comics in the top 20 each month compared to DC. They still sell more issues than DC every month and combined with the fact that all of Marvel's titles are at least $3.99 cover price while DC has very few titles with a higher than $2.99 cover price. As a result, Marvel usually edges out DC in comics sold, but crushes them in total sales.

And the main reason is while none of Marvel's titles are consistently crushing it in sales, they're consistent on most of their back end and lower tier comics. While DC basically has Batman... and that's it.

Last month DC had half of the top 20 comics. 8 of those were comics starring Batman (Batman x2, Detective Comics x2, All-Star Batman, Batman Annual, and Justice League x2) and they occupied the 1, 2, 4, 7, 12, 13, 16, and 19. The other two comics were the two issues of Flash released last month and they were 17 and 20.

Basically DC dominates the top 20, Marvel dominates 20 through 150.

Random side note:
